Resolved best47 training config has three start offsets, not one globally. Worker assignment cycles over those choices and is fixed per runner; seeds do not alter time when random_init false. Effective historical counts must be independently verified.

Motor angles match joint angles, motor speeds match joint speeds, spring initially has zero deflection, plugin extra states and controls reset; biological muscle activation/fiber and controller/SO memory reset too.
Actor only reads35 prefix; ex_novo omits4 imitation-target features and gait clock disabled. Actor served-ref/previous endpoint initially inherit IK and later follow policy/governor memory.

Full system still uses biological IK tracking continuously, prescribed sound-side GRF and privileged critic biological IK. Thus initial IK is not the sole prescribed dependency of training/plant. Direct prescribed prosthetic waveform reward is disabled by blend_reference=0 in snapshot; bio score can still carry IK support objective.
